Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Thomas Carr death year from a search-result snippet (1957) and did not open/verify the Wikipedia page, ignoring conflicting results (e.g., 1997 on IMDb and DC Database). Thomas Carr (director) actually died in 1997, later than Frank R. Strayer (1964), so the correct film with the earlier-deceased director is Tangled Destinies. The erroneous reliance on the snippet led to a wrong conclusion and mis-citation.
